text: Mukhtasar nuqsan aur ashab-e-falah-o-najat: Asr se murad zamana hai jis mein insan neki badi ke kaam karta hai, Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam (R.A) ne is se murad Asr ki namaz ya Asr ki namaz ka waqt bayan kiya hai lekin mashhoor pehla qaul hi hai. Is qasam ke baad bayan farmata hai ke insan nuqsan mein, toote mein aur halakat mein hai. Haan is nuqsan se bachne wale woh log hain jin ke dilon mein iman ho, aamal mein nekiyan hon, haq ki wasiyatein karne wale hon yani neki ke kaam karne ki, haram kamon se rukne ki dusre ko takeed karte hon, qismat ke likhe par, musibaton ki bardasht par sabr karte hon aur dusron ko bhi isi ki talqeen karte hon. Saath hi bhali baton ka hukum karne aur buri baton se rokne mein logon ki taraf se jo balayein aur takleefein pahunchein to un ko bhi bardasht karte hon aur isi ki talqeen apne sathiyon ko bhi karte hon, yeh hain jo is sarih nuqsan se mustasna hain. Surah Al-Asr ki tafsir bihamdillah khatam hui.
